prompt.label: Phone notifications
prompt.title: Get a notification when something needs your decision
prompt.body: You have just approved your first item. Turn on notifications and we will tell you when the next one is waiting. Notifications never show your customers' messages.
prompt.done: Notifications are on for this device. You can choose what to be told about in Settings.

ios.title: Add Pivoris to your Home Screen to get notifications
ios.step1: Tap the Share button in Safari.
ios.step3: Open Pivoris from the new Home Screen icon and turn on notifications there.
ios.note: An iPhone or iPad delivers notifications only to apps added to the Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or later).

outcome.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser settings, then try again.
outcome.disabled: Notifications are not set up on this server.

settings.title: Phone notifications
settings.intro: Get a notification on this phone or computer when something needs you. Notifications never include customer messages.
settings.deviceOn: Notifications are on for this device.
settings.deviceOff: Notifications are off for this device.
settings.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser. Allow them in the browser settings, then come back here.
settings.unsupported: This browser cannot receive notifications. Use Chrome or Edge on Android, or open Pivoris from the Home Screen on an iPhone.

approvals.label: Approvals waiting for me
approvals.hint: Replies and posts that need your decision.

questions.label: Questions from my assistant
questions.hint: When the assistant needs information from you.

failures.label: Problems
failures.hint: A post or reply that failed, or an Instagram account that must be reconnected.

settings.quiet: Between 22:00 and 08:00 (workspace time) only urgent notifications are sent: an Instagram account that must be reconnected, or an approval about to expire.
settings.devicesNone: No device has notifications turned on yet.
